nodes.label: Graph Export Targets (Wiki/Neo4j/FalkorDB/SVG/GraphML)
nodes.rationale: Each export runs only on its own flag; Cypher exports use MERGE so re-runs are idempotent; FalkorDB prefers direct push because GRAPH.QUERY has no bulk script import.

nodes.label: Graphify MCP stdio Server
nodes.rationale: Exposes query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path so other agents can query the graph live; Claude Desktop config must use the absolute interpreter path because it cannot run shell substitution.

nodes.label: Token Reduction Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Only runs when total_words > 5000 - for small corpora the graph's value is structural clarity, not token compression.
